Capsule endoscopy revealed blood in the upper jejunum and the ileum. Double‐balloon endoscopy revealed vascular malformations in the deep jejunum and ileum (Figure 1b,c). We first treated the VM in the jejunum and ileum by polidocanol injection therapy. panels.rationale: Single axial T2-weighted head/neck MRI of a real patient from a BRBNS case report. Multiple lobulated hyperintense lesions are visible in the bilateral cheek soft tissues and tongue (white arrows), matching the in-text description of numerous venous malformations of the cheek, tongue, parotid, submandibular and sublingual spaces. Venous malformations are the hallmark manifestation of blue rubber bleb nevus syndrome, so disease attribution is strong. The dilated_venous_channels finding_key is used because the MRI demonstrates the same venous-malformation pathology (dilated thin-walled venous channels) in vivo; the MRI-specific appearance is added as a proposed finding. No age or ethnicity is stated in the caption or in-text (the article title says 'Malay girl', but per rules only caption/in-text are used for those fields), and skin tone is not assessable on MRI.
